_note: Net debug panel layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 255.

text._note: max_width wraps every line; the default colour is used when a line names none; the outline is the same for all.

room_code._note: max_chars: the code is cut after this many characters, with an ellipsis.

log._note: rows: how many event lines stay shown (the oldest go first); join_code_chars: the joined code is shown cut to this many characters.
